o: Martian is a CIA agent living undercover in his own life. Samia, his lover, is a political prisoner in Sudan, and he will do anything to try and save her, even past the point of treachery. The only way out is deeper in, which is a knife-edge Martian must walk if he is to save love, life, and his mission.
